author: Mark Atwood
text:
Escalating: workspace-canonical-template decision per the bead's own framing ("Decision should be workspace-wide, not chat-client-only").

Per workspace AGENTS.md "Canonical Templates", mail-client is the canonical extension-client template; all 6 sibling extension-clients (chat, calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing) mirror its shape. Mail-client uses elided `SetResponse` everywhere. Any divergence in chat-client violates the cookie-cutter rule.

Three coherent workspace-wide outcomes:

1. **Status quo (do nothing).** Accept the silent dependency on upstream's `T = serde_json::Value` default. Cheap. Risks a future jmap-types refactor breaking every consumer. Recommendation: file a `lock-it-down` test in jmap-types itself that asserts `SetResponse: Default<T=Value>` (compile-time guard) so the canonical-template stays intact even if someone touches the upstream default. Closes the bead with rationale.

2. **Make elision explicit, workspace-wide.** Search-and-replace `SetResponse` -> `SetResponse<serde_json::Value>` in every public signature across mail-client AND all 6 extension clients. Non-breaking (the resolved type is identical). Doc-style only. Removes the silent default-dependency. Adds verbosity at every call site.

3. **Adopt typed responses for `/set` create methods, workspace-wide.** Change `chat_create -> SetResponse<jmap_chat_types::Chat>`, `message_create -> SetResponse<Message>`, etc., paralleling the change in mail-client (`email_set -> SetResponse<Email>`). Breaking change. Better caller ergonomics. Bigger workspace-wide pass. Need to think through what `notCreated` looks like (still `Option<HashMap<String, SetError>>`?), what `updated` looks like (per-id partial-object map), and how `properties` filtering interacts.

Recommendation: (1) for now — file a `lock-it-down` test in jmap-types under JMAP-x2gd-ish, close this bead with rationale citing the workspace-canonical-template rule. Option (3) is the right caller-experience win but needs its own dedicated workspace epic with bd:JMAP-* scoping; do not commit to it incrementally.

Filing as human because the decision is public-API breaking across 7 sibling crates (workspace AGENTS.md "When NOT to file human" anti-pattern 3 explicit exception for public-API breaking).
